name: hok_minimap_hd_bootstrap_dev
notes: Local experimental-only HD bootstrap v2 candidate. Train: video1+8+3+4+5+10 (664 images/1211 boxes); development val: video2-HD+11 (230 images/400 boxes), used for model and confidence selection; test is empty, so these are not independent results. Threshold confidence=0.49, NMS=0.5. Safe crop from the reviewed video10/11 record is [44,0,408,334) on 1920x860 frames; widget/direction ROI is [96,0,372,277). Strict PyTorch-to-ONNX raw parity failed (max 0.000595391 > 0.0005). Strict TorchScript-to-ncnn raw parity failed (max 0.001058936 > 0.0005); Android-equivalent detection coordinate parity also failed (max value error 0.433487 > 0.01) despite matching detection counts on all 230 images. Keep verified=false and public defaults off. Runtime remains behind the explicit allow_experimental toggle; no physical-device validation has been run.
